title: console-tooling-standup-2026-05-19.json
content:
Date: 2026-05-19
Attendees: Avery Chen (owner), Marcus Patel, Nia Rodriguez, Samir Khan, Elena Gupta, optional: Priya Rao (infra)

Agenda:
- Quick sync: UI polish, rollout scheduling, analytics dashboard metrics
- Blockers and release gates for v2 rollouts
- Action items and owners for next week

Notes / Updates:
1) UI / Frontend- Marcus: shipping updated model selector component today (PR 1287) — fixes keyboard focus issues and improves a11y labels. QA found one visual regression on the model card when the description is long; working on CSS clamp fix. Target hotfix branch if regression persists after tomorrow's e2e run.
- Nia: Profile page routing refactor merged last night; noticed increased bundle size (~30KB) due to new intl polyfill. Investigating dynamic import to lazy-load only needed locales.
- Design: Elena provided updated spacing tokens for the rollout modal. Marcus to update stylesheet variables and re-run visual snapshots.

2) Rollouts / Backend orchestration- Samir: rollout-controller now supports percent-based canaries for dedicated/dedicated-plus tiers. Deployed to staging; observed successful fallback behavior when a variant returns 503. Need to add metric for 'fallback_rate' to help trigger automated rollback.
- Avery: rollout schedule for v2 rollout (customer beta) tentatively set to 2026-05-26 16:00 UTC. Requirements: analytics event schema finalized, SLA smoke tests green, and manual rollback documented in runbook.
- Blocker: infra autoscaler bug (JIRA-4688) can cause brief cold starts when scaling from 0 to >4 replicas. Priya to include a mitigation (warm pool) in infra next deploy. This must be resolved or covered by canary window policy before production rollout.

3) Analytics / Observability- Nia: dashboard for per-route token cost and latency SLO is mostly complete. Need to add labeling for rollback events and model-variant mapping. Also adding a custom alert: sustained latency > 1500ms p50 on any route for 5min.
- Action: Samir to add 'fallback_rate' and 'canary_success_rate' to the console metrics pipeline (telemetry team) by EOD Friday.

4) QA / E2E- QA: smoke tests to run against staging tomorrow (2026-05-20) covering: canary traffic split, fallback behavior, and console UX flows (create rollout, pause, rollback). Marcus to add missing test for long description in model card.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with customer beta rollout on 2026-05-26 16:00 UTC if infra autoscaler mitigation is in place OR canary window extended to 30 minutes with manual approval.
- Require telemetry for 'fallback_rate' before enabling automatic rollback rules.

Blockers / Risks:
- Autoscaler bug (JIRA-4688) — high risk for customer-facing beta.
- Potential visual regression on model card if CSS fix not applied.
- Bundle size increase from intl polyfill could affect cold-start render for users on slow networks.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Marcus: finish model card CSS clamp fix and visual snapshot run (2026-05-20).
- Priya: deliver autoscaler warm-pool mitigation plan and tentative roll (2026-05-21).
- Samir: add 'fallback_rate' and 'canary_success_rate' metrics to telemetry pipeline (2026-05-22).
- Nia: implement lazy-load for intl locales and remeasure bundle size (2026-05-21).
- Avery: finalize rollout runbook + manual rollback steps, notify CS of beta window (2026-05-21).

Follow-ups / Notes to self:
- Link runbook draft in Confluence once Avery finalizes: confluence://console-rollouts/runbook-v2 (TODO)
- Check with infra on whether warm-pool increases cost significantly for Dedicated customers; prepare cost note for sales if so.

Quick wins / small improvements:
- Add tooltip text on rollout percentage slider to explain effect to non-technical PMs (Elena will draft copy).
- Add unit test for model selector focus to catch regression discovered in PR 1287.

Next meeting: 2026-05-26 15:00 UTC (final pre-rollout sync)

Misc links referenced:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1287
- Jira: JIRA-4521 (model selector a11y), JIRA-4688 (autoscaler warm up)
- Confluence design: confluence://console-rollouts/design-v2
- Slack thread: slack://C02ABCD1234|thread_ts=1710600000.000200

Status: in_review — please comment on the doc for any concerns before EOD 2026-05-20.
